evidence.why: Table association, exact signature, unused input and ordered unconditional calls.
Setters write the pending flag and destination directly.

reason: Canonical table associates the callback with toy collection. Its void GameModeState* body ignores the argument and unconditionally selects GM_MENU then marks a mode change pending; canonical callee bodies confirm the two state writes. These support all five complementary function claims without implying an immediate scene switch.
